feature_definition: RATIO_RTE_TREND = RTE / TREND. RTE = Shannon entropy (nats) of white vertical line length (recurrence-time gap) distribution: per column j, gap lengths w of consecutive zeros between recurrent points excluding i==j; qualifying w>=w_min (w_min=1), p_w=n_w/sum_u n_u, RTE=-sum_w p_w*ln(p_w); fail-closed if <2 distinct qualifying gap lengths or entropy non-finite/non-positive. TREND = least-squares slope of recurrence point displacement (1-based index j>=1 along each qualifying diagonal line, from its start) vs j, pooled over all qualifying diagonal-line recurrence points (k!=0, l>=l_min=2); fail-closed if regression undefined or |TREND|<=1e-18. On trailing delay embedding (m=2,tau=1), L-inf recurrence eps=0.5*std(window). Causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if RTE/TREND/ratio undefined/non-finite/degenerate or insufficient qualifying lines/gaps.
